name: GitLab
description: GitLab describes itself as "an intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps," an end-to-end platform covering the software lifecycle from planning to security to deployment.
best_for: Targets enterprises, small businesses, and public-sector organizations, with named industry solutions for financial services, telecom, automotive, aerospace, education, and government.
features: GitLab Duo Agent Platform (AI agents for issues to merge requests)
Value stream management / DORA metrics analytics
Epics, iterations, and agile planning tools

alternatives.name: GitHub
alternatives.description: A developer platform combining source control, CI/CD (Actions), and AI coding assistance (Copilot).
alternatives.best_for: Teams of any size, from learners to enterprises, building software collaboratively.

alternatives.name: Bitbucket
alternatives.description: Atlassian's Git platform centered on Jira integration and built-in Pipelines CI/CD.
alternatives.best_for: Jira-centric teams wanting tight planning-to-code integration.
